## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
ROTATION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: Financials, Materials and Industrials showing broad strength while Tech leadership is concentrated — style tilting Value/Cyclical.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Materials lead: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +6.48% | 1M: +22.97%) ABOVE TREND. Financials strong: C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, MS (1W: +5.15% | 1M: +9.94%) ABOVE TREND. Technology rally pockets: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Consumer Staples showing weakness: PEP (1W: -3.74% | 1M: -0.63%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY; AMD (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +4.30%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION; MET (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +6.02%) CORRECTION; MDT (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -8.38%) BELOW TREND; CMCSA (1W: -2.02% | 1M: +11.17%) CORRECTION; KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select consumer names and some healthcare equipment.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W movers: FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: several large caps (AVGO RECOVERY, AAPL RECOVERY, GOOGL RECOVERY) show 1W vs 1M mismatch — tactical volatility, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Tech mixed with concentrated leadership: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: -8.37%) RECOVERY. Sector-level 1W: +2.60% across 19 stocks; rotation within Tech requires watching 1M follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials constructive and broad: JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND, C (1W: +6.73% | 1M: +19.03%) ABOVE TREND, SCHW (1W: +4.79% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND. Sector-level 1W: +2.78% across 20 stocks; favors cyclical/value exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed: MRK (1W: +6.05% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +1.12% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +0.46%) CORRECTION. Sector 1W: +1.93% across 15 stocks; watch drug-trial headlines for idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Favor Financials and Materials exposure given breadth-positive rotation and cyclicals leadership; reduce exposure to names showing 1W/1M divergence in Tech. Monitor recovery patterns (AVGO, AAPL, GOOGL) before treating gains as durable.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +9.98% | 1M: +0.49%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TSLA (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -3.71%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -2.51% | 1M: -3.64%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Financials (1W: +2.78%, 20 stocks) and Materials (1W: +3.44%, 7 stocks) — watch earnings/capital flow into cyclicals. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -0.90%, 12 stocks) and Utilities (1W: -0.66%, 6 stocks) — defensives lagging in current rotation.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
NVDA: sustain above recent 1W breakout to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AAPL (1W: +0.44% | 1M: -1.29%) RECOVERY — watch for 1M mean re-test for confirmation; JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND — keep an eye on rate-sensitive flow; FCX: hold short-term strength to validate materials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
META (+50): Meta Platforms (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +4.34%) CORRECTION — AI growth headline aligns with positive 1M trend but 1W softness shows short-term hesitation. MA (+50): Mastercard (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +6.06%) ABOVE TREND — partnership news confirming ongoing strength. WMT (+50): Walmart (1W: -2.69% | 1M: +4.64%) CORRECTION — bullish headline but price is pulling back short-term (divergence).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
TSLA (-45): Tesla (1W: -1.69% | 1M: +13.30%) CORRECTION — probe headlines add to short-term volatility despite strong 1M. JNJ (-50): Johnson & Johnson (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +0.46%) CORRECTION — trial termination news aligns with 1W softness (confirming). JPM (-45): JPMorgan (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND — negative chatter on accounts is sentiment risk but price remains strong (divergence to monitor).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION: Value/Cyclical style.  
Stocks showing strength: NVDA (1W: +9.41% | 1M: +7.15%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.68% | 1M: +29.15%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.22%) ABOVE TREND.  
Key risk: Major divergence across large caps (several RECOVERY/CORRECTION patterns) and mixed news flow (TSLA/JNJ headlines) — watch for trend confirmation before adding conviction.
